items.title: Want Double-Digit Gains From Insurance Stocks? Morgan Stanley Suggests 2 Names to Consider
items.summary: Insurance has spent the past 20 years doing many of the things investors usually appreciate, without getting much credit for them. The industry has returned cash through dividends and buybacks, produced relatively dependable earnings, and attracted famous long-term investors such as Warren Buffett. What it has not done particularly well is turn steady business growth into equally strong profit growth.
